_comment: Audience protocol mapper for the shahin-bff client. Required so that access tokens minted for the OIDC code flow include aud=shahin-bff and pass the platform KeycloakTokenVerifier audience check (KEYCLOAK_AUDIENCE=shahin-bff). Apply with: kcadm.sh create clients/<shahin-bff-client-uuid>/protocol-mappers/models -r dogan -f shahin-bff-audience-mapper.json
name: audience-shahin-bff
